name: Chibimoth
source:
[url=/c241]Kotori's[/url] pet dog that says "mosu mosu" as opposed to barking.

[spoiler]He real and birth name is Pero(ペロ). He was abused by his previous owner via cutting his ears and due to the abuse he didn't live long and later was resurrected by Kotori.[/spoiler]
